{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure sentinel)
initial_rows = len(df)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
print(f'Removed {initial_rows - len(df)} rows with biomarker_baseline == -999')

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# First, verify that there are indeed duplicates
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print(f'Number of patients with multiple entries: {len(duplicates)}')

# Keep only the highest sample_seq per patient
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of unique patients
enrolled_patients = len(df)
print(f'Final number of enrolled patients: {enrolled_patients}')"}
